arrive.text: A locked room. Cards come in through a slot in the wall, covered in marks you can't read.

ask.text: There's a rulebook. You don't need to understand the marks. Only to match them.

book.text: A huge rulebook. For every card that comes in, it shows you which card to send back.

sent.text: You post it back. Outside, someone reads it.

wrong.text: Wrong card. Outside, a puzzled pause.

heap.text: Thousands of cards, all answered. You never found out what any of them said.

reveal.text: Outside, a woman has been asking you questions. How are you. Do you like tea. What's the weather like. You answered perfectly.

understand.text: To her, whoever is in the room speaks fluent Chinese. You don't know a single word.

end.text: If following the rules isn't understanding, what is? And is a computer, following its rules, any different from you?

stop_end.text: You stop answering. The cards pile up by the slot.
